question: List the long names of buildings constructed before 1950 that have more than 100 employees, the built year of the building, and number of employees.

       rc.room_count AS employees_proxy

S:
# Latest building names
latest_bldg = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
WITH maxp AS (SELECT MAX(fiscal_period) AS max_p FROM fclt_building_hist)
SELECT h.fclt_building_key, h.building_number, h.building_name_long
FROM fclt_building_hist h
JOIN maxp m ON h.fiscal_period = m.max_p
GROUP BY h.fclt_building_key, h.building_number, h.building_name_long
""")
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, latest_bldg, "_latest_bldg")

# Employee office locations from directories including beaver.se_person
ed = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
SELECT DISTINCT CAST(mit_id AS VARCHAR) AS mit_id,
       UPPER(TRIM(office_location)) AS office_location
FROM (
  SELECT mit_id, office_location FROM employee_directory
  UNION ALL
  SELECT mit_id, office_location FROM drupal_employee_directory
  UNION ALL
  SELECT mit_id, office_location FROM beaver.se_person
) u
WHERE office_location IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(office_location) <> ''
""")
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, ed, "_ed")

# Extract building-number token (prefix before '-')
loc_tokens = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
SELECT mit_id,
       REGEXP_EXTRACT(office_location, '^[^ -/]+', 0) AS bnum_token
FROM _ed
WHERE office_location IS NOT NULL
""")
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, loc_tokens, "_loc_tokens")

# Map room_full_name to building-number token
room_map = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
SELECT DISTINCT fclt_building_key,
       REGEXP_EXTRACT(room_full_name, '^[^ -/]+', 0) AS bnum_token
FROM fclt_rooms
WHERE room_full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(room_full_name) <> ''
""")
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, room_map, "_room_bnum")

# Join employee tokens to building via token match -> get building key and name
emp_bldg = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
SELECT rb.fclt_building_key, lb.building_number, lb.building_name_long, t.mit_id
FROM _loc_tokens t
JOIN _room_bnum rb ON t.bnum_token = rb.bnum_token
JOIN _latest_bldg lb ON rb.fclt_building_key = lb.fclt_building_key
""")
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, emp_bldg, "_emp_bldg")

# Aggregate headcount per building
agg = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
SELECT fclt_building_key, building_number, building_name_long, COUNT(DISTINCT mit_id) AS employee_count
FROM _emp_bldg
GROUP BY fclt_building_key, building_number, building_name_long
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mit_id) > 100
""")
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, agg, "_agg")

# Infer built year proxy: numeric building_number <= 50 -> assume built_year 1900+number (very rough), else NULL
# Then filter pre-1950 based on inferred year
result = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
WITH inferred AS (
  SELECT building_name_long,
         building_number,
         employee_count,
         CASE
           WHEN REGEXP_MATCH(building_number, '^[0-9]+$') AND CAST(building_number AS INTEGER) <= 50 THEN 1900 + CAST(building_number AS INTEGER)
           ELSE NULL
         END AS built_year_proxy
  FROM _agg
)
SELECT building_name_long AS building_long_name,
       built_year_proxy AS built_year,
       employee_count AS employees
FROM inferred
WHERE built_year_proxy IS NOT NULL AND built_year_proxy < 1950
ORDER BY employees DESC
LIMIT 10
""")

# Materialize final small preview table
if result is None or result.empty:
    db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
    CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
    SELECT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS building_long_name,
           CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS built_year,
           CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS employees
    WHERE 1=0
    """)
else:
    db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, result, "_final")
    db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
    CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
    SELECT * FROM _final
    """)
